announced on Wednesday that it won an $876.4M contract modification from the U.S. Navy for continued development of the Next-Generation Jammer Low Band system.
The work includes system development, demonstration test pods, cybersecurity, testing, software, and logistics support for the Navy and the Royal Australian Air Force.
The work is expected to be completed in fiscal 2031.
About $26.7M in funds will be obligated at the time of the award.
Naval Air Systems Command is the contracting activity.

title: L3Harris Technologies wins $876M Navy contract boost to advance next-gen jammer
